name: skill-authoring
when_to_use: When authoring, creating, explaining, or inspecting declarative domain skills (brain/skills/<name>.json).
steps: Phase 1 — Specification: Define kebab-case name, target domain, triggers, when_to_use, required tools, and verification checks.

Phase 2 — Implementation: Draft declarative schema adhering strictly to schema_version 1 with structured steps (Inspection -> Implementation -> Verification) and forbidden_actions (all banned actions included).
Phase 3 — Persistence & Verification: Save valid JSON directly to 'brain/skills/<name>.json' and verify syntax without elevating permissions or modifying builtins.
Output Rule: When asked how skills are created, reply in 1-3 concise plain-text lines in third person without dumping raw JSON schemas or decorative boxes.
verification: read_file confirms brain/skills/<name>.json is valid JSON with schema_version 1
response to creation inquiries is 1-3 concise plain-text lines in third person
